why:
I checked the verifier brief's items against the issue's expect lines. It has no Advisory heading, so the stricter checks sit directly inside items 1–6:
- Item 4 asks the verifier to "mutate lint() mentally or briefly, e.g. break line numbering, and confirm a test would fail". That is a mutation test, and the words "node:test tests for..." don't require it.
- Item 6 checks that the "branch name matches CLAUDE.md convention (<type>/<issue>-<slug>, no claude/ prefix, under 60 chars)" and that the "diff is limited to this tool plus README/lock changes". Expect line 6 asks for neither the branch rule nor the file-scope rule.
- Item 2 asks for "nothing on stdout", and item 1 adds CRLF and empty-file cases. Expect lines 1 and 2 don't require either.
- Item 4 also requires package-lock consistency, which expect line 4 doesn't state.
All of these count toward pass/fail rather than sitting under an Advisory heading, so the criterion fails.
